response: Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture the exact configuration you rely on—status, assignee, due date, grouping, and more—and return to it in a single click. Every team member can create and store up to 50 saved views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, planning a sprint, or monitoring a specific client's work, your setup is always ready when you need it. Views aren't just personal: share any saved view with your team so everyone sees the same filtered list, without explaining how it was built or repeating setup steps. Saved Views works across list, board, and calendar layouts, and updates automatically as tasks change, so the view stays accurate over time. It's one more way to help your team stay organized as projects grow more complex. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
